entries.dialogueText: "More women in the workforce sounds nice on paper. But it's unfortunately not as simple as that."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""In the wake of the President's rec..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the wake of the President's recent legislation, do you plan to act further to increase women's rights?"

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""Women across Sordland have been ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Women across Sordland have been marching for equal rights throughout the Rayne presidency -- do you plan on addressing their demands?"

entries.dialogueText: "I'll stop you right there."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""Anything to add, Mr. President?""
entries.dialogueText: "Anything to add, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""You can't expect a man -- and a di..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can't expect a man -- and a divorced man at that -- to know what's best for Sordish women."

entries.speaker: Manoly Suheil
entries.title: Manoly Suheil: ""Says the woman running for Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: "Says the woman running for President! Do you not see a contradiction here?"

entries.speaker: Moderator

entries.dialogueText: "But what about the argument that more women in the workforce leads to greater productivity as a nation--"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No. Next question.""
entries.dialogueText: "No. Next question."

entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""As your president, I would create..."
entries.dialogueText: "As your president, I would create policies specifically aimed at women from disadvantaged communities, so that no female Sord is lifted up at the expense of another."
